units.source_text: 黑因为白130败着，产生了五目之差，

en.t: Because of White 130, the losing move, Black fell behind by five points,

units.source_text: 这在破白模样之前，谁也没有预料到。

en.t: and before White's framework was broken, no one had expected that.
After White 130, roughly up to White 160,

units.source_text: 不觉疏忽了“17·十八”先手的断，

en.t: they somehow overlooked the sente cut at 17-18,

units.source_text: 以致失去了名人所说的“多少缩小一点败差”的机会。

en.t: and as a result lost the chance, as the Master put it, to reduce the margin of defeat somewhat.

units.source_text: 这样看来，即使存在白130败着，

en.t: Seen in this way, even with White 130 as a losing move,

units.source_text: 也可以将差距控制在五目以内，三目左右。

en.t: the gap could still have been held within five points, around three points or so.
If there had been no losing move at White 130,

units.source_text: 就不会发生“惊天动地”的逆转，

en.t: then the earth-shaking reversal would not have occurred,

units.source_text: 那这盘棋的胜败将会如何？

en.t: so how would the outcome of this game have turned out?

units.source_text: 我不认为黑子会败下阵来。

en.t: I do not think Black would have gone down to defeat.

units.source_text: 看见大竹七段面对这盘棋的精神准备和态度，

en.t: Seeing Otake seventh-dan's mental preparation and attitude toward this game,

units.source_text: 我几乎相信即使白吃掉几个子，黑方也会取胜。

en.t: I was almost convinced that even if White captured a few stones, Black would still win.
